content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Foreign Languages Centre Language modules French French HTW Berlin offers courses for business French, preparation courses for the nationally recognised UNIcert® language certificate and courses for general language. In each case you may select a level based on your ability from beginners, intermediate and advanced.
